chunks: O you assembly of jinns and men, did not apostles come to you from among you, communicating My signs to you, bringing warnings of this your day (of Doom)? They will answer: We bear witness to our sins. They were surely deluded by the life of the world, and bore witness against themselves because they were unbelievers.

key_terms.شَهِدْنَا عَلَىٰ أَنْفُسِنَا: We bear witness to our sins
key_terms.لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا: Meeting of this your day (of Doom)

ai.seo_question: What is the response of jinns and humans on the Day of Judgment regarding their disbelief?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-An'am, this verse highlights the universal scope of prophethood, addressing both jinns and humans to emphasize that messengers were sent from among their own communities. It underscores the concept of self-testimony (shahid anfusahum) on the Day of Judgment, where the delusion of worldly life (gharrat-humul-hayat ad-dunya) leads to their own admission of disbelief, a theme central to Shia eschatological reflections on accountability.
